row: For over 35 years, Palm Beach Equine Clinic has offered an unwavering commitment to the care of your horse, whether an Olympic athlete or reliable trail horse. Our goal is to keep your horse healthy and happy while extending their performance career. With Palm Beach Equine Clinic veterinarians located around the globe, our clients have access to the country’s top veterinarian services with the assistance of state-of-the-art diagnostic tools and surgical equipment.
